title: Bluehost Pricing: Plans, Renewal Rates (2026 Guide)
summary: Bluehost pricing for shared plans starts at $3.99–$13.99 monthly but renews at $9.99–$20.99. Review all plans and renewal rates to budget for hosting.
body_markdown:
## Hidden Bluehost Costs and Limits People Hit


The costs that break a Bluehost budget are the renewal rate and the domain's own renewal fee. The add-ons offered at checkout and the resource ceilings that push you to a bigger plan do the rest.


The first bill looks fine, and the failures arrive twelve to thirty-six months later, when the invoice no longer matches the sheet.


### Renewal price jump


At signup you pick a term, the promotional rate applies to that term only, and the next invoice uses the standard rate. That is where the failure chain starts.


The renewal-by-term chart shows that the renewal rate depends on the term you bought, so the term belongs on your sheet as its own column. Budget on the renewal figure, because that's what you pay for every term after the first.


Billed separately from hosting, the domain renews at its own rate, which varies sharply by extension. A cheap-looking name can become one of your larger recurring lines.


Domain Privacy, which hides your registration details from public lookups, is an extra charge. Price it before you decide you can go without.


During checkout, backup and security products appear as pre-selected or suggested items. CodeGuard handles automated backups and SiteLock handles malware scanning. If you accept them by default, they sit on every renewal. Decide per site whether you need them, and write the answer down.


### Bluehost shared plan limits and upgrade triggers


Once traffic or a heavier plugin load slows the site, the fix is a higher plan at a higher renewal rate. Shared plans cap storage, site count and server resources.


Check each limit on the plan page for your site size before purchase, because the upgrade is the line most sheets omit.


Treat the checklist below as a pre-purchase audit. These figures come from our notes and weren't rechecked against Bluehost's live pages for this draft, so confirm each one on the checkout page and date it before relying on it.


-


Starter renewal is $9.99 against a $3.99 intro rate, so the real monthly cost is more than double the advertised one.


-


Domain renewal runs from $22.68 for.org to $93.48 for.store, **so your extension can outweigh the hosting difference** .


-


Domain Privacy is $15 per year, which recurs at every domain renewal.


-


CodeGuard starts at $47.88 per year, so skipping it means arranging your own backups.


-


**The refund window is 30 days** , which ends long before the first renewal, so you can't test the renewal price risk-free.
